name: cronward
author: Frestina
description: Whether the GitHub Actions workflows cronward starts on a schedule passed, failed or didn't run, from cronward's own results. Holds no token and makes no network calls of its own; works on the machine that runs cronward or on a laptop that watches it.

barWidget.description: Bar icon that stays quiet while every cronward job passes, and turns red or orange with a count when one failed or didn't run, or the main machine stopped ticking. Click for each job's result and next slot; middle-click to check now.

schema.label: Main machine
schema.description: Blank when cronward runs on this machine. On a viewer, the main machine as you would type it after ssh, the same as for cronward install --viewer.

schema.label: cronward command
schema.description: The command or its full path. The default also finds ~/.local/bin/cronward when the shell's PATH lacks it.

schema.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often it reads cronward's status. Local and cheap: on a viewer it reads the copy cronward fetched, and Check now fetches a new one.
